name: frogoe
description: Write a closure, ship a game. One defineGame closure with four nouns, and a CLI that scaffolds, serves, gates, and bundles feed-ready games as single self-contained HTML files.

interface.shortDescription: Write a closure, ship a game
interface.longDescription: Build games from one closure with Frogoe. Define games with stage, input, loop, finish, use the CLI for the dev loop (init/run/check/bundle), and install reusable HUD registry blocks. The platform draws nothing — your game owns the look.
defaultPrompt: Make a game where you hold to charge a jump
Add a score HUD to this game
